task_summary: Verify WakePoint robustness across all real-world scenarios & alarm modes, then rewire the demo simulator

phases.name: Phase 1 — Mode-aware alarm evaluator (faithful to the app)

steps.title: Mirror the 4 alarm modes from Dart
steps.description: Port the exact trigger logic from alarm_controller.dart into the Python harness: stops (N stations before, using the dwell-count station index), time-metro (ETA≤N min), distance-nonmetro (X km before via route progress + straight-line fallback), time-nonmetro (ETA≤X min, eligibility-gated: 100m traveled + 3 GPS + 30s). Replace the current 500m-proxy alarm_metric entirely.

steps.title: Build the ETA-distribution + critical-fractile fire rule
steps.description: Implement the research-derived decision theory: Monte-Carlo push the EKF (s,v) posterior through a schedule-anchored segment-sum (metro) or d/v ratio (road) to get an arrival CDF; fire on the one-sided ε-quantile rule so wider σ fires earlier. Validate against the existing underground result (must still give ~100% on the solved case).

steps.title: Extend synthesizer to walk & road legs
steps.description: Add pedestrian (step-and-heading + real foot-stop ZUPT) and road-vehicle (higher speed, no rail curvature, traffic stops) generators to the existing metro synthesizer, all emitting device-frame IMU + gold s(t) on a known polyline.

steps.title: Compose multi-leg journeys with transitions
steps.description: Chain legs: walk→station, drive→station, GPS-restricted approach, board (walk→stationary→vehicle), in-metro, line-switch (alight→transfer-walk→board), alight→walk-out. Mark transition instants for the change-point detector. Add excessive-motion (fidget/jostle) and GPS-degraded (urban-canyon multipath, not just blackout) as edge overlays.

steps.title: Run the scenario×mode×edge corpus
steps.description: Vectorize the pipeline (the current per-sample loop is too slow at 94s/ride), then run all applicable journey-leg × alarm-mode cells across the edge axes (phone rate/carry/GPS/motion/route/timing), multiple seeds each. Record alarm hit-rate, lead-error, in-blackout error, NEES per cell.

steps.title: Build the failure-Pareto and robustness report
steps.description: Identify which scenario×mode cells pass/fail, rank failures by frequency×severity, and for each failure name the specific fix (per-fix adaptive GPS R, map-aided cross-track gate, transition Q-inflation, mode-specific eligibility). Deliver a robustness report + multi-panel figure.

phases.name: Phase 4 — Rewire the demo simulator to the real EKF

steps.title: Replace the fake-EKF interpolation with the real filter
steps.description: ekf_replay_panel.dart:159 computes ekfProgressMeters as elapsed/total×distance — a fake. Wire the real EKF (production ekf_pipeline.dart or the fixed variant) fed by synthesized/replayed IMU so the simulator shows true filter behavior: the ZUPT stall, the blackout, covariance growth, and the fix recovering it.

steps.title: Add mode-aware alarm + uncertainty visualization
steps.description: Show the alarm firing per the selected mode, the σ envelope around the position estimate, and the target/lead marker, so a demo visibly proves the fix. Verify end-to-end in the dashboard against a known synthetic journey.

steps.title: Write the sim-gated port spec
steps.description: For each fix proven in Phases 1-3 (honest covariance, motion-gated ZUPT, dwell-count association, learned velocity, per-fix GPS R, cross-track gate, transition handling, mode-aware fire rule), give the exact Dart file/line target and the sim evidence that justifies it. Order by confidence: cheap high-confidence (Steps 1+2) first, learned components after real-data validation.

desired_outputs: A mode-aware alarm evaluator that tests all 4 modes (N stops / N minutes / X distance / X time) instead of the 500m proxy
A multi-leg journey synthesizer covering walk→drive→GPS-restricted→board→metro→line-switch→alight, with domain-randomized phones/carry/motion
A large scenario×mode×edge-case corpus with per-cell alarm hit-rate, lead-error, and failure-Pareto
A robustness report ranking which scenarios pass/fail and what each failure needs
The web simulator rewired to run the REAL EKF (not the fake linear interpolation) and visualize true filter behavior + alarm firing for demos
Verified Dart port recommendations for the fixes, gated on sim evidence

feasibility.rationale: The EKF port, synthesizer, silver reference, and verified underground fix already exist and are proven; this extends them to more scenarios and wires the demo. Main uncertainties: only ONE real ride exists (all new legs — walk, drive, line-switch — are synthetic-only until more real data is captured), and the mode-aware alarm logic must be faithfully mirrored from 1290 lines of Dart. Both are manageable but mean results are 'verified in simulation' pending real multi-scenario rides.
